name: CORT.AMORIM SGPS NAM.EO 1
summary: CORT.AMORIM SGPS NAM.EO 1 is a Portuguese company involved in the cork industry. Corticeira Amorim is the world's largest producer of cork products, including stoppers for wine bottles, flooring, and insulation materials. The company operates globally and is a major player in the cork sector.
